text.tspan: MI-LSTM / multiplicative gate integration | Operators & tensor flow
Gate preactivation only / I12,H16 / alpha,beta_i,beta_h,bias supplied / read bottom to top
Gate width4H=64; all three terms have the same static[B,64] shape.
Shared Wx/Uz producers fan out to distinct real operand ports; colors do not imply weight sharing.
The top boundary ends before chunk4; the standard LSTM suffix is outside this figure.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
